name: Hinge Study
description: A circular set of joints opening into a quiet, imperfect mechanical flower.

assets.credit: Original geometric line study · Tampa Curated

compatibility: Current Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge with Canvas 2D and ES modules.
Static preview and documentation work without JavaScript.
Reduced motion starts paused. Touch does not require hovering.
Fullscreen uses the browser API when available, with an expanded-page fallback.
notes: Framework-independent Canvas 2D. No React, Three.js, external fonts, images, or network services are required.
The host controls animation. Reusable buffers are unnecessary for this small 2D study; drawing count is bounded by the inspector.
Pointer movement influences the drawing; the same study also works without pointer input.
reuse: Extract the source ZIP, then serve the folder over local HTTP. Open example.html.
Import mount from the experiment entry, pass a sized element and settings, then call setRunning(true).
Call update(settings) to apply changes, replay() to restart, and dispose() before removing the host.
Use the included validated preset.json. Framework integration belongs in your application, outside the effect.
